subject.title: [Bug] QQ Bot: skill_workshop approval "Allow" button always recorded as rejected

question: Should receipt of a QQ Bot C2C approval prompt itself grant approval authority when no explicit non-wildcard approver is configured?
rationale: Current code and documentation require explicit actor authorization, while the paired pull request would make every direct-conversation sender implicitly authorized; only maintainers can choose that trust boundary.

options.title: Keep explicit authority
options.body: Retain the authorization gate and repair routing or UX so only a configured approver receives actionable buttons, with clear setup guidance otherwise.

options.title: Trust direct senders
options.body: Treat every C2C sender as an approver and explicitly accept the resulting self-approval exposure for bots using open DM access.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit authority
recommendation.body: Retain the authorization gate and repair routing or UX so only a configured approver receives actionable buttons, with clear setup guidance otherwise.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent QQ Bot authorization hardening makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the security-boundary choice.
